en: A gift for General Castor, with compliments from General Hector Penny of the Arcadian 6th.  The following note was attached: "Remember this? I certainly do - You ripped it right from my  lieutenant's hands, and then turned and shot our would-be assassin with it. The renegade would have gunned down the whole Crusade's high-command, if not for you. I thought you might appreciate the souvenir. "
zh_new: 這是阿卡迪亞第六團赫克托·彭尼將軍贈予卡斯托將軍的禮物，隨附字條寫道：「記得這東西嗎？我當然記得。你直接從我副官手中奪過它，轉身就用它擊斃了企圖刺殺我們的兇手。若不是你，那名叛徒本會掃倒整個遠征軍高層。我想你會喜歡這件紀念品。」
